notes: Second downshift campaign: the 5-family x 3-difficulty x 2-rung matrix from #318/#367 (15 tasks x 2 arms x 3 attempts x 2 model rungs = 180 trials), agentify pinned to github:ixigo/agentify#7cd5351, subscription OAuth. Interrupted twice by host-side background-process kills (at 145/180 and 177/180) and finished via `harbor job resume` (completed trials untouched; the two in-flight trials of the second interruption were re-run). CORRECTION HISTORY, because the first write-up of this campaign was wrong: it published 32/0 discordant across four families and four qualifying cells and asserted no crash-discordants. Review found four of those agentify wins had a crashed baseline opposite them; fixing the import to preserve Harbor's exception_type (it had been mangled to '[object Object]' for every failure) revealed the cause as two NetworkConnectionErrors and two non-zero exits INSIDE the agent install command, before any model ran. Zero-activity setup failures are now classified as non-gradeable harness errors, and error_type is persisted in every receipt. Published numbers are post-correction: suite-level (#322 rule) WINNER agentify — pooled 86 gradeable pairs, 84/86 (98%) vs claude-code 56/86 (65%), discordant 28/0 spanning 2 task families (avoid-unbounded-fanout 16, avoid-cache-regression 12; avoid-roster-mutation, recall-error-envelope and reject-stale-config-path tied), exact sign p = 7.45058e-9, Wilson CIs separated (91.9-99.4 vs 54.6-74.4); PER-CELL (#317 target) MET for the first time in two cells: haiku-4-5 hard 6/0 (p=0.03125) and sonnet-4-5 medium 6/0. Arm totals include agentify's 10 provider_error attempts (mid-run failures with real activity, graded against agentify per #367) and exclude the 4 baseline harness errors above.
